#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Round 6: reason precedence and cross-cutting combinations."""
import json, subprocess, sys

CTX = {
    "directory": {"sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"]},
    "accounts": {"s": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": []}},
    "gateways": {"g": {"local_domains": ["studio.test"], "peers": {"p": ["studio.test"]}}},
}
def run(jobs):
    batch = dict(CTX); batch["jobs"] = jobs
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                          input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr[-2000:]
    return json.loads(proc.stdout)["results"]

GOOD = ("MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q\r\n"
        "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\nCall-ID: c\r\nCSeq: 9 MESSAGE\r\n"
        "P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\nhi")
BAD = GOOD.replace("Call-ID: c", "Call ID: c")

fails = []
def check(name, jobs, expect):
    got = run(jobs)
    if got != expect:
        fails.append(name); print("FAIL %s\n  got %s\n  exp %s" % (name, json.dumps(got), json.dumps(expect)))

def rej(r):
    return {"status": "reject", "reason": r}

# syntax beats unauthenticated / identity
check("syntax-over-untrusted", [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "untrusted"},
                                 "trusted_out": True, "raw": BAD}], [rej("syntax")])
check("syntax-over-local-unknown", [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "zz"},
                                     "trusted_out": True, "raw": BAD}], [rej("syntax")])
check("syntax-over-peer-unknown", [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "peer", "name": "zz"},
                                    "trusted_out": True, "raw": BAD}], [rej("syntax")])
check("syntax-over-peer-nopai", [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "peer", "name": "p"},
                                  "trusted_out": True, "raw": BAD.replace(
                                      "P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n", "")}],
      [rej("syntax")])

# unauthenticated beats identity
check("unauth-over-identity", [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "zz"},
                                "trusted_out": True, "raw": GOOD}], [rej("unauthenticated")])
check("peer-unknown-over-identity", [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "peer", "name": "q"},
                                      "trusted_out": True, "raw": GOOD}], [rej("unauthenticated")])
nopai = GOOD.replace("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>\r\n", "")
check("peer-nopai-over-identity", [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "peer", "name": "p"},
                                    "trusted_out": True, "raw": nopai}], [rej("unauthenticated")])

# upstream only depends on the earlier decision
check("upstream-beats-syntax", [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "zz"},
                                 "trusted_out": True, "raw": BAD},
                                {"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "zz"},
                                 "trusted_out": True, "source": 0}],
      [rej("syntax"), rej("upstream")])
check("upstream-beats-unauth", [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "untrusted"},
                                 "trusted_out": True, "raw": GOOD},
                                {"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "untrusted"},
                                 "trusted_out": True, "source": 0}],
      [rej("unauthenticated"), rej("upstream")])

# untrusted never accepts, regardless of From / PPI / PAI / trusted_out
for raw in (GOOD, nopai, GOOD.replace("From: <sip:ember@studio.test>",
                                       "From: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"),
            GOOD.replace("From: <sip:ember@studio.test>", "From: <sip:zz@else.test>")):
    for out in (True, False):
        r = run([{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "untrusted"}, "trusted_out": out, "raw": raw}])[0]
        if r != rej("unauthenticated"):
            fails.append("untrusted"); print("FAIL untrusted", json.dumps(r))

# a peer is not authoritative for a locally hosted domain unless listed
CTX2 = {"directory": CTX["directory"], "accounts": CTX["accounts"],
        "gateways": {"g": {"local_domains": ["studio.test"], "peers": {"p": []}}}}
check("peer-empty-authority", [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "peer", "name": "p"},
                                "trusted_out": True, "raw": GOOD}], [rej("identity")])

print("%d failures" % len(fails))
PYEOF
